profile.headline: Software engineer @ Motiv
profile.summary:
As a Full Stack Developer at Motiv, I spearhead a team of developers, orchestrate work, and assign tasks. I also guide teams throughout the development process using monolithic and microservices architecture. I apply Agile methodology throughout the software development lifecycle and mentor junior developers on best practices.

I have in-depth knowledge of NodeJS and JavaScript, and I develop and optimize APIs to handle large volumes of data, managing asynchronous workloads for system and service integrations. I work with server-side rendering to enhance speed and user experience, and I leverage React Redux for frontend development, employing Material UI and Bootstrap for styling. I implement and maintain both SQL and NoSQL databases. I have a certificate degree in Ingeniería de telecomunicaciones from Universidad Central "Marta Abreu" de Las Villas. I am passionate about innovation, technology, and development, and I thrive in team-based or individually motivated settings.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Spearheaded a team of developers, orchestrating work, and assigning tasks. Additionally, guided teams throughout the development process utilizing monolithic and microservices architecture.
Applied Agile methodology throughout the software development lifecycle.
Mentored junior developers on best practices in software development.
Developed and optimized APIs to handle large volumes of data using Node.js and JavaScript, managing asynchronous workloads for system and service integrations.
Worked with server-side rendering to enhance speed and user experience.
Implemented and maintained both SQL (MySQL, MariaDB) and NoSQL databases.
Leveraged React Redux for frontend development, employing Material UI and Bootstrap for styling.
Established custom configurations with WebPack and Babel for optimizing the React environment.
Managed and optimized server infrastructure on Oracle and AWS instances, leveraging Debian and Ubuntu Server as operating systems.
Implemented and configured reverse proxies like Nginx, SSL certificates, and managed DNS settings. Part of the infrastructure was deployed using Docker.
Conducted continuous deployment development using Jenkins, and trained the team to work under this model.
Monitored server performance metrics and optimized accordingly.
Initiated automated testing processes to ensure code quality.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Suggested and implemented new ideas to improve quality, reduce cost, and support
production work environment.
Reviewed project specifications and design technology solutions that met or
exceeded performance expectations.
Orchestrated efficient large-scale software deployments, including testing features
and correcting code.
Used metrics to monitor application and infrastructure • performance.
Reviewed existing systems and make recommendations for improvements.
Worked with teams of talented software engineers to define, build and maintain cloud
infrastructure.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Managed to do large-scale software deployments, including code proofing and
correction(reactJS[front-end] and express[Back-End]).
Reviewed project specifications and designed technology solutions that helped to
meet performance expectations.
Project progress was discussed with clients, feedback on different stages was
collected, and concerns were directly addressed.
Discussed project progress with customers, giving feedback with comprehensive
analysis of obtained test results.
Implemented new software applications.
Built web platform and in 6 months, increasing visualizations and sales in exponential
graph[run on AWS].
Built web platform using (JavaScript and Typescript) which increased product
visualizations and sales in exponential trend.

positions.title: Program Specialist
positions.description:
• Managed company resources, increasing test system efficiency and decreasing the time required to
obtain results by 30%.
• Collaborated with the manufacturing team to design new test equipment for products under
development.
• Generated software to install operating systems on motherboards using C# and C++, writing over USB
using Altera drivers.
• Identified components, supplies, and equipment needed to support testing.
• Debugged and fixed issues with thermal test equipment.
